description: FIToFI Payment Cancellation Request must contain a Case.Id.
Cancellation reason code (CxlRsnInf.Rsn.Cd) must be a valid ExternalCancellationReason code.
Cancellation request must identify the Assigner (Assgnmt.Assgnr).
Cancellation request must identify the Assignee (Assgnmt.Assgne).
Each Underlying transaction must reference an OrgnlUETR.
errorMessage: Underlying transaction must reference an OrgnlUETR (or at minimum OrgnlTxId) for the cancellation to be processable.
fix: Add <OrgnlUETR>uuid-v4</OrgnlUETR> identifying the payment being cancelled.

name: CBPR_From_Assigner_BIC_FormalRule
description: When AppHdr/CpyDplct is absent: AppHdr/Fr BICFI must match Assgnmt/Assgnr/Agt BICFI.
errorMessage: AppHdr <Fr> BICFI must match <Assgnr> Agt BICFI when CpyDplct is absent.
fix: Align AppHdr <Fr> BICFI with Assgnmt/Assgnr/Agt BICFI.
